title: 序章 · 你的房间
premise: 录音笔里存着别人说过的话。你把这些话译出来，哑才能一点一点把声音接回去。

lines.zh: 你先别急着回他，等我把这边的事弄完，我陪你一起过去。
lines.en: Don't rush to get back to him. Let me wrap up here and I'll go over with you.

lines.zh: 这雨看着不大，走两步鞋就全湿了。
lines.en: The rain doesn't look like much, but two steps out and your shoes are soaked.

lines.zh: 我记得上次来这家店还挺便宜的，怎么现在涨了这么多？
lines.en: I remember this place being pretty cheap last time — how come prices have gone up so much?

lines.zh: 你要是赶时间就先走，别等我，我这儿还得好一会儿。
lines.en: If you're in a hurry, go ahead — don't wait for me, I'll be a while.

lines.zh: 他不是不想来，是这两天实在走不开。
lines.en: It's not that he doesn't want to come; he just can't get away these couple of days.

lines.zh: 你有没有觉得，明明是周末，反而比上班还累。
lines.en: Don't you feel like the weekend wears you out more than work does?

lines.zh: 手机快没电了，我先挂，回头微信上跟你说。
lines.en: My phone's about to die, so I'll hang up and message you later.

lines.zh: 这事你别跟他说是我讲的，不然他又得念叨我半天。
lines.en: Don't tell him it came from me, or he'll be on my case for ages.

lines.zh: 帮我个忙行吗？我这边会走不开，取不了快递。
lines.en: Can you do me a favor? I'm stuck in a meeting and can't pick up the package.

lines.zh: 我这周一直想给你打电话，可事情一件接一件地堆着。
lines.en: I've been meaning to call you all week, but things kept piling up.

lines.zh: 说实话，这种天气我宁愿待在家，也不想出门。
lines.en: Honestly, I'd rather stay in tonight than go out in this weather.

lines.zh: 等一下，我看一眼——钥匙好像落在台面上了。
lines.en: Hold on, let me check — I think I left the keys on the counter.

lines.zh: 不是什么大事，不过下次能提前跟我说一声就好了。
lines.en: It's not a big deal, but it'd help if you could tell me in advance next time.

lines.zh: 要不各付各的，要不这顿我来，晚饭你请。
lines.en: We can split it, or I'll get this one and you cover dinner.

lines.zh: 抱歉来晚了，路上堵得厉害，还找不到车位。
lines.en: Sorry I'm late — the traffic was awful and I couldn't find parking.

lines.zh: 地址我发你。二楼右手边第一个门，敲门就行。
lines.en: I'll text you the address. Second floor, first door on the right — just knock.
